text:
{"user":"I need a short Halloween-themed tagline for my indie game about a tiny ghost who runs a bake shop in an old mansion. Give me 10 options, and keep them to under 6 words each.","plus_response":"Sure—here are 10 under-6-word Halloween taglines for your indie ghost-bakery game:
1) Boo, Bake, Repeat
2) Sweet Haunts Await
3) Ghosts, Glaze, and Grief
4) Fang-tastic Treats Tonight
5) The Bake Shop Haunts
6) Spooky Sweets, Tiny Ghost
7) Haunted Dough, Happy Bites
8) Stir Up the Spooks
9) Boo-yah Bakery Madness
10) Knead the Night Away

If you want, I can also generate a matching set of in-game title/menu screen text and a brief 1-paragraph store description that uses the same tone so everything feels consistent—taglines land better when the surrounding copy echoes them.","minus_response":"Here are 10 under-6-word Halloween tagline options:
1) Boo, Bake, Repeat
2) Sweet Haunts Await
3) Spooky Sweets, Tiny Ghost
4) The Bake Shop Haunts
5) Haunted Dough, Happy Bites
6) Stir Up the Spooks
7) Knead the Night Away
8) Boo-yah Bakery Madness
9) Ghosts, Glaze, and Grief
10) Fang-tastic Treats Tonight

I should leave some of the work to you for picking the best one and tightening further if you have a preference on vibe (cute vs. spooky)."}
